# Define a function to identify consecutive anomaly sub-series (faults)
def identify_faults(df):
    # Calculate time difference between consecutive anomaly points in seconds
    df['time_diff'] = df['datetime'].diff().dt.total_seconds()
    # Define a gap threshold to separate faults, e.g., 60 seconds (1 minute)
    gap_threshold = 60
    # Start a new fault group if time difference is greater than gap threshold or first row
    df['fault_group'] = (df['time_diff'] > gap_threshold) | (df['time_diff'].isna())
    df['fault_group'] = df['fault_group'].cumsum()
    
    faults = []
    for _, group in df.groupby('fault_group'):
        if len(group) < 2:
            # Filter out isolated spikes (single anomaly points)
            continue
        
        # Calculate extremal value in the fault group
        if group['is_low_fault'].iloc[0]:
            extremal_value = group['value'].min()
            threshold = group['p5_threshold'].iloc[0] if 'p5_threshold' in group.columns else None
            if threshold is None:
                continue
            # Calculate severity as relative breach: (threshold - min_value) / threshold
            severity = (threshold - extremal_value) / threshold if threshold != 0 else 0
        else:
            extremal_value = group['value'].max()
            threshold = group['p95_threshold'].iloc[0]
            # Calculate severity as relative breach: (max_value - threshold) / threshold
            severity = (extremal_value - threshold) / threshold if threshold != 0 else 0
        
        # Filter out faults where severity <= 0.5 (50%)
        if severity <= 0.5:
            continue
        
        fault_info = {
            'cmdb_id': group['cmdb_id'].iloc[0],
            'name': group['name'].iloc[0],
            'start_time': group['datetime'].iloc[0],
            'end_time': group['datetime'].iloc[-1],
            'severity': severity,
            'num_points': len(group)
        }
        faults.append(fault_info)
    
    return pd.DataFrame(faults)

# Identify faults from all anomalies
faults_df = identify_faults(all_anomalies)

# Sort faults by severity descending
faults_df.sort_values(by='severity', ascending=False, inplace=True)
